title: Human-approved cross-domain research through September 1 at 06:30 JST
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 1 request to continue research across the remaining system-software 15, application 18, operations/procurement 13, governance 2 and cross-cutting 5 existing research units. Preserve the current classification and historical evidence. Research public primary sources, implementation and measurement conditions, release and service stages, counterevidence and cross-domain adoption dependencies. Prepare bilingual provisional catalog/roadmap updates and reviewable PRs under the existing publication workflow. Around 2026-09-01 06:30 JST, stop at a coherent boundary after recording the exact state, validated changes, unfinished work and restart instructions. Single-agent/single-model research must stay partial, provisional and Consensus incomplete; do not close Gaps or make unvalidated performance/cost extrapolations. This transcribes authorization to prepare the continuation for public review, not approval of scientific conclusions, a production merge/deployment, unattended agents, restricted material, hardware experiments or financial commitments.
